title: Animated Stars
shortDescription: Watch a star-filled sky drift over four landscapes, with 30 constellation figures, optional names, shooting stars and aurora. Customize motion, horizon color and the local clock. Works offline. An imagined sky, not a live view from your location.
longDescription: Turn your TV into a quiet night sky with 2,486 catalog stars and 30 constellation figures. Watch the constellation gently appear. Choose Violet Mountains, Twilight Lake, Desert Mesa or Open Sky, and customize the horizon color and star rotation speed. Add subtle twinkle, occasional aurora, shooting stars, and your Roku's local clock and date. Reduced Motion slows the sky and pauses decorative effects. Animated Stars works offline, with no accounts, ads or subscriptions. Star patterns use Hipparcos catalog positions in an imagined rotating sky; this is not the current sky from your location or an observing guide. Aurora and shooting stars are decorative. Preferences and Credits & Licenses are available in Change screensaver settings. Press a remote button to leave the screensaver.
